comment: The statement that a component should not be interpreted as a prescription to procure a specific system is important, but it does not explain how countries should package components for procurement. Separate procurement of every logical component could create unnecessary fragmentation.

anchor.note: p.25 l.Lines 39-41 read as the printed page; section 2.1 agrees

public.text: The statement that a component should not be interpreted as a prescription to procure a specific system is important, but it does not explain how countries should package components for procurement. Separate procurement of every logical component could create unnecessary fragmentation.
public.suggestedRevision: Add a note that logical components may be procured or implemented together where appropriate, provided that component boundaries, interfaces, data ownership, portability, and conformance obligations remain explicit.
